what_this_is: DI onset on the Stage B withholding world, measured with the frozen engine on consumed design-block seeds in each claimed configuration. It measures the predictor only; no outcome is scored.
why_it_exists: protocol 3.3: the world that carries `held_out_next_tag` had never had its predictor measured, so the run could not start.
predictor: DI onset under the protocol's rule -- the first cycle of the first qualifying sustained run, not the first non-zero reading
cells_are: consumed Phase L seeds, regenerated; no Stage B seed is spent
limits: design-block seeds per configuration characterise the onset distribution; they are not the confirmatory block and they authorise nothing
the world is a reconstruction of the scale family, so an onset measured here is not the Phase L onset and may not be compared with the published medians
the confirmation cycles are the protocol's Phase L medians, used to size each run; they are not re-derived from these onsets
no relation between onset and any behavioural outcome is computed here, and none may be read off this artifact
the engine is single-threaded per cell and deterministic per seed, so a cell is not a replication of itself; these are different seeds, not repeated measurements
a cell stops a margin after its onset, so `final_di` is the DI at the stop point and not at the end of the behavioural window; a censored cell ran the full horizon
the 5- and 20-cycle rules are evaluated on a trajectory truncated 25 cycles after the 10-cycle onset, so a longer rule can be censored where the shorter one is not
